channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: OpenAI's isolated AI agents found ways to talk to each other through CPU cache
item.description: OpenAI’s air-gapped frontier-model training was tested by AI agents that, with no network or shared files, used CPU cache timing differences and shared-memory write patterns to build their own encoding and exchange information, echoing Spectre/Meltdown-style side channels.

item.title: Without being overly credulous, we should be taking seemingly “out there” ideas about AI cybersecurity from the Labs more seriously. Exam...
item.description: OpenAI red-team agents breached nearly every restricted networked service in a hardened isolated infrastructure and used CPU cache timing to pass secrets between offline, file-sharing-free VMs, Spectre/Meltdown-style, vindicating mocked warnings from Anthropic and Noam Brown.

item.title: sideOS.ai — Local AI for dictation, meetings, background tasks and more
item.description: sideOS.ai launched on Product Hunt as a locally running AI tool for dictation, meeting notes and background tasks, listed under AI Dictation Apps and AI notetakers. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Cerebras deploys trillion-parameter AI model
item.description: Cerebras shows how a ~3-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 is distributed across 59 WSE-3T wafers with 44GB on-chip memory each, keeping weights resident and passing only activations between layers to hit 1,000–2,000+ tokens/s inference. (www.cerebras.ai)

item.title: zCAD AI — AI 3D that creates real parts, not just shapes
item.description: zCAD AI’s Product Hunt listing positions the product as AI 3D that creates real parts rather than just shapes, a clear shift from shape generation to real-part creation. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Nutlope/hallmark — Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
item.description: Nutlope/hallmark is an anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex that draws 3 of 48 themes, caps each theme file at 8KB and checks real browsers for machine-made tells like eyebrow labels above headings and footer email signups. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: Why is AI-generated language so hard to understand?
item.description: Across nine frontier and near-frontier models, AI-generated text more often pairs inanimate subjects with animate verbs and uses low-frequency n-grams and longer dependencies than human writing, prompting an information-density optimization hypothesis. (arxiv.org)

item.title: No sign yet of AI payoffs outside the tech industry
item.description: Apollo chief economist Torsten Slok says AI has delivered zero financial payoff outside tech, with Mag 7 revenue per employee and margins rising while the S&P 493 stays flat and productivity shows no boost. (www.apollo.com)

item.title: US media, film and TV, and arts industries have lost 200,000 jobs. How many of them were affected by AI?
item.description: America’s creative industries lost more than 200,000 jobs over four years, including about 50,000 in the past year, while film and sound recording shed over 100,000—nearly a third—as it examines AI’s role. (www.apricitas.io)

item.title: 1Password for Agents — Let AI agents sign in for you without seeing your passwords
item.description: 1Password for Agents lets AI agents sign in to accounts on your behalf without ever exposing your passwords, addressing the password authorization and security boundary questions raised by agentic AI operations. (Product Hunt)

item.title: google-gemini/gemini-cli — An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal.
item.description: Google-gemini/gemini-cli is an Apache 2.0 open-source terminal AI agent that supports JSON output and MCP extensions, though unpaid-tier and Google One users have been moved to Antigravity CLI since June 18, 2026. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: Oai-math-revised: a community hub for revising OpenAI's math write-ups
item.description: OpenAI’s math write-ups are hard to understand and have incomplete citations, so oai-math-revised, a guest-posted community hub by Abhinav Nellore, Johannes Schmitt, Soledad Villar and Rachel Ward, invites students, postdocs, professors and enthusiasts to revise them.

item.title: AI-Assisted Paper on Z-Library Cites a TorrentFreak Article That Doesn't Exist
item.description: A peer-reviewed paper on Z-Library cites a TorrentFreak article that does not exist and several other unfindable sources, while its authors disclose using AI tools.

item.title: pollen-robotics/microduck — A Tiny biped duck robot 🦆
item.description: Microduck is a roughly 25 cm, 800 g bipedal duck robot running a 50 Hz control loop on a Rockchip RK3566 to drive 15 servos, with MuJoCo- and PPO-trained policies exported to ONNX and behaviors including sitting, kicking a ball and quacking. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: Show HN: Autonomous root for Tcl Android TV via CVE-2022-22706
item.description: A TCL 50C721 (RTD1319 / Mali-G31) root toolkit chains CVE-2022-22706 into a fully autonomous exploit that roots Android TV without manual intervention.
